description: Gold questions for the sample corpus in data/sample_docs. 'questions' reuse the document's own wording; 'paraphrase' questions deliberately share little vocabulary with the answer (synonyms, rephrasing), which is where lexical retrieval breaks down. 'doc' and 'page' give the page that answers the question; 'answer_all' lists lowercase substrings the final answer must contain. 'split' is frozen: configurations are chosen on 'dev' and reported on 'test'. Question 18 was seen failing before the split was frozen, so it lives in dev. The paraphrase set was written after the first evaluation run showed the original set was saturated.
